provider: CPU-reference video-process provider plus object/feature provider

rows.remaining: The provider proves the D3D12 video object ABI, one feature query, descriptor ownership, and exact descriptor round trips. VideoToolbox decode/encode/process execution, profiles, format conversion, metadata, asynchronous video queues, and protected video remain open. No video capability is promoted from this row.

The CPU-reference provider covers one RGBA8 texture input, nearest-neighbor scaling, one output stream, queue submission, fence completion, and exact readback. VideoToolbox decode/encode, NV12/P010 conversion, references, metadata, protected video, and broader processor filters remain open.
Requires a VideoToolbox/CoreVideo provider, codec/profile matrix, exact decoded/encoded comparison, queue synchronization, and lifetime evidence.
